notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Bold blue theme with pill status, dark mode and good row/column labels, but empty bottom row renders squashed on the end screen and cells stay focusable after the game ends.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Clean and correct, but cell aria-labels are static 'Cell n' so screen readers never hear the marks, and the bottom row is squashed in play.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Square stable board, dark mode, aria-labels that include the mark, a visible focus ring, clear win highlight and a sound alternating-first-player restart.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Correct logic, but static 'Cell n' labels hide marks from screen readers, there is no focus style or dark mode, and the bottom row is squashed.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Cells keep a fixed square size so the board never shifts, with row/column aria-labels, a live status, a win highlight, and alternating first player.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: The logic is correct and compact, but the bottom row shrinks once the other rows fill in, and cell labels are just 'Cell n' with no focus styling.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: The logic is correct and it has a focus ring and role=status, but the bottom row squishes during play, and the leftover starter='O' before reset() is a hack.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: The blue palette and status pill look distinctive and it has good labels and dark mode, but the bottom row squishes during play and aria-disabled leaves finished cells focusable.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Correct and simple, but cells only say 'Cell n' to screen readers, there is no custom focus style, and the look is plain.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Correct and tidy, with row/column/state aria labels, a focus ring, dark mode and a 44px button; the draw message is a bit wordy.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Bold, friendly blue look, but the board rows visibly squash at the end state, and aria-disabled cells still take clicks and focus.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: Correct and clean, but screen-reader labels are bare 'Cell n' and the starter-flip setup is awkward.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Plain, complete two-player game with row/column aria-labels, live status, clear win highlight, dark mode and a solid phone layout; no layout glitches.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Correct with scores and alternating starter, but the board rows squash unevenly once marks appear, labels are only 'Cell n', and there is no cell-state announcement.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Best-looking with SVG marks, arrow keys and focus handling, but it adds a computer opponent, scoreboard and mode toggle (overbuilt) and the board rows visibly squash at game end.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Smallest and cleanest working game with a fixed grid that stays stable, but only 'Cell n' labels, no focus styling, and a bare look.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Nicest SVG marks and win highlight plus good a11y, but adds a computer opponent, scoreboard and loser-starts rule beyond 'basic', and the board rows visibly squash once marks appear.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Small, correct and clean with stable fixed-size cells, but screen-reader labels are just 'Cell n', there is no focus style, and the look is plain.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Simple and correct with a nice thick-grid look and alternating starter, but rows squash when marks appear and labels are only 'Cell n'.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Basic, correct, with descriptive row/column labels, aria-live status, dark mode, large touch targets, clear win highlight and stable layout.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Clean, compact and correct with a score tally and clear win highlight, but cell labels do not announce marks and there is no focus style.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Nicest SVG marks, dark mode and arrow keys, but it adds an unrequested computer opponent and loser-starts rule, and the bottom row collapses once marks are placed.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Exactly a basic game with a stable board, strong contrast, dark mode, focus rings, descriptive labels and a live status, and no layout glitches.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Simple and tidy with a nice framed board, but the board rows distort after moves, cell labels are only Cell n, and there is no focus-visible polish for marks.
